title: precheck warns when researched would read a research goal's lead-in together with its first question
goal: backlog.py precheck prints a warning for a research item whose goal_questions output joins a lead-in sentence of more than QUESTION_LEAD_WORDS words to its first question, naming the item, so a planner moves the lead-in to notes before the start gate; in SP-5dffnlxn the first worker found it after its claim and ten goals were re-planned mid-sprint.

run:
import sys, os, json, tempfile, subprocess, pathlib
ENV = dict(os.environ, GIT_AUTHOR_NAME='a', GIT_AUTHOR_EMAIL='a@example.com', GIT_COMMITTER_NAME='a', GIT_COMMITTER_EMAIL='a@example.com')
def run(goal):
    t = pathlib.Path(tempfile.mkdtemp()); d = t/'_backlog'; d.mkdir(parents=True)
    sp = {'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','kind':'sprint','title':'s','status':'planned','goal':'g'}
    it = {'id':'ST-cccccccc','kind':'story','title':'research','status':'draft','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','priority':'P1','rank':0,
          'goal_research':True,'goal':goal,'checks':[{'run':['python3','-c','import sys; sys.exit(1)']}]}
    (d/'SP-aaaaaaaa.json').write_text(json.dumps(sp)); (d/'ST-cccccccc.json').write_text(json.dumps(it))
    for a in (['init','-q','-b','main'],['add','-A'],['commit','-q','-m','plan']):
        subprocess.run(['git',*a],cwd=t,env=ENV,check=True,capture_output=True)
    r = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'_tools/backlog.py','--root',str(t),'precheck','SP-aaaaaaaa'],capture_output=True,text=True)
    return [l for l in r.stdout.splitlines() if l.startswith('warning:') and 'ST-cccccccc' in l]
long = 'Research with the kb tools first and the live docs for gaps, written as kb facts and gap entries through /kb-research: (1) Which Claude Code parallel-work option isolates a session?'
short = 'Research with the kb tools first through /kb-research: (1) Which Claude Code option isolates a session?'
a = run(long); b = run(short)
sys.exit(0 if a and not b else 1)

notes: Seen again 2026-10-16 in SP-rsmmwzr2: ST-unrlktke's goal (1) piece starts with a 21-word lead-in ('Research with the kb tools first ... through /kb-research:'), so goal_questions keeps it and the pack of the whole piece is weak (not in the kb: kb-research; 19 of 24 key words) while the same question without the lead-in is good (15 of 15). The worker cannot make the kb hold 'kb-research' honestly; the goal needs the lead-in in notes. Seen again 2026-10-17 in SP-4dab3cy5: ST-5mcrotet's goal (1) piece starts with the same 21-word lead-in, so researched reads it with the first question (FAIL none, kb lacks: Research, live, written, gap, kb-research) while the status line question alone packs good (12 of 13 key words) once claude/statusline.md exists. The worker cannot make the kb hold 'kb-research'; the lead-in has to move to notes.
